hooks.command: if [ -x ./bin/zqk ]; then ./bin/zqk agent hook pre-subagent --vendor antigravity; else zqk agent hook pre-subagent --vendor antigravity; fi

Stop.command: if [ -x ./bin/zqk ]; then ./bin/zqk agent hook continuation --vendor antigravity; else zqk agent hook continuation --vendor antigravity; fi
